queries.name: GetRfcLifecycleProjection
queries.output: current accepted RFC source fields with exact evidence references, derived status_class/authority, current terminal epoch if any, local archive state, unresolved warnings
queries.ordering: single result; source fields render in closed field-registry order
queries.rule: source evidence bodies/history are read through LLD-04; this query exposes accepted current ticket projection only

queries.name: GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade
queries.output: pending proposal identity/revision/terminal evidence/epoch, scope fingerprint, exact RFC/WFM member counts and one bounded immutable captured-member page
queries.ordering: member_kind_ordinal ASC where RFC=0 and WFM=1, captured ordinal ASC, member immutable ID ASC
queries.rule: executed/superseded history is not returned as executable pending authority; this query exposes persisted proposal evidence only and never recomputes or mutates scope

queries.name: PreviewRfcTerminalCascade
queries.output: persisted scope fingerprint and exact counts versus freshly recomputed scope fingerprint/counts, stale reasons, one bounded cross-domain impact page, and deliberate-confirmation requirement
queries.ordering: impact_domain_ordinal ASC where Tickets=0,TasksObjectives=1,Communications=2; impact_kind ASC; entity_id ASC
rules: full-scope comparison/fingerprint is computed server-side before paging and does not require materializing the entire result in transport memory
no scope refresh or downstream mutation
INDETERMINATE participant preview fails closed for execution readiness

queries.name: PreviewRfcArchive
queries.output: server-computed exact full-scope fingerprint/member count plus one bounded page of member IDs/revisions/archive states and change/exclusion classification
queries.ordering: scope ordinal ASC, rfc_id ASC; exact_rfc has ordinal 0, reviewed_branch is root ordinal 0 then direct children ordered rfc_id ASC
rules: fingerprint binds the complete current scope and member revisions even though transport is paged
branch preview contains only current root plus direct subordinates and introduces no child-count business cap
command recomputes the complete fingerprint inside the writer UnitOfWork rather than trusting a client-supplied member list

queries.name: GetRfcArchiveOperation
queries.output: immutable requested scope/fingerprint, exact archived-member count, one bounded operation-member page with latest per-member archive event and current restore eligibility
queries.ordering: operation member ordinal ASC, rfc_id ASC
queries.rule: operation membership never implies that a member is still archived by that operation after later independent actions

queries.name: PreviewRfcHardDelete
queries.output: eligible boolean, exact RFC revision, bounded typed blocker summaries, per-domain determinate/indeterminate guard results, bounded provider freshness tokens and eligibility_fingerprint
queries.ordering: closed guard registry ordinal ASC, blocker code ASC
rules: blocker summaries are bounded by the closed local/provider guard registry; detailed provider-owned history remains behind provider reads rather than being copied into this preview
manual creation audit is classified separately from post-creation protected history
any source adoption/provenance, relationship/history/lifecycle/archive/correction dependency or INDETERMINATE provider makes eligible=false
command recomputes every guard and fingerprint inside the deletion UoW

pagination: Every unbounded RFC lifecycle evidence/impact/member surface uses CURSOR_V1 keyset paging with packet-bounded page_size. Full-scope safety decisions use server-computed counts/fingerprints over indexed reads and never depend on an unbounded client payload.
